# vf2 (Virtua Fighter 2, Version 2.1; Model 2A-CRX): entry points the recompiler cannot
# find by itself. The MAME harvest (scripts/run_trace.sh's branches.txt: indirect-branch,
# interrupt and IAC targets, interrupted addresses) over attract runs of 1,800, 3,600
# and 8,000 frames and an 8,000-frame fight (coin, start, punch and kick), merged with
# scripts/seed_scan.py's candidates. The code runs from the program ROM (no RAM copy).
# Addresses only (our own analysis; rules.md rule 7). One hex address per line.
# Cleaned 15 Oct 2026: 1,093 harvested addresses inside straight-line code (interrupted
# addresses: the code before them already reaches them) dropped, as were 0xa440 (the
# second word of lda 0x36006c6c at 0xa43c) and nothing else: the recompiler reaches the
# same 54,504 instructions without them. Five function starts the harvest only showed
# from inside (0x8630, 0x11590, 0x115a8, 0x11970, 0x119c0) added at the end.

# routines 0x93c4-0x947c are called as balx 0x93xx/0x9444,r14 with their text
# inline after the call and return past it (0x947c bx (r14): the words up to the
# first one <= 0xffffff); 0x4ec00 returns 8 bytes past the call (0x4ec08 bx
# 0x8(r14)). Every such return point, computed from the program ROM's 461 + 42
# calls (15 were already seeds).
